profile_text.body:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a subsidiary of Amazon, a public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, WA, trading under the ticker AMZN. AWS reported revenue of $716,924,000,000 for the period ending 2025-12-31, as filed in a 10-K. The company's website for this profile centers on Amazon SageMaker, which AWS describes as a unified development environment for data, analytics, and AI workloads.

Amazon SageMaker is positioned as a full machine learning lifecycle platform that brings together model development, generative AI, data processing, and SQL analytics in a single interface called SageMaker Unified Studio. The site highlights tools including HyperPod, JumpStart, and MLOps capabilities within SageMaker AI, alongside Amazon Q Developer, which the company describes as an AI assistant for software development tasks such as data discovery, model building, SQL query generation, and pipeline creation through natural language. The platform supports data access across Amazon S3 data lakes, Amazon Redshift data warehouses, and third-party federated sources, using a lakehouse architecture compatible with Apache Iceberg, and includes governance features such as Amazon SageMaker Catalog, data classification, toxicity detection, and ML lineage tracking. AWS also offers AWS Bedrock, a separate managed foundation model API service with IAM integration, VPC support, model evaluation tools, and an AgentCore component for agent orchestration.

No litigation or MCP server records are held for Amazon Web Services in the site's current data.
